bss.topic: Revisão do 1º trimestre: da crise colonial ao Segundo Reinado

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Em que ano a família real portuguesa chegou ao Brasil, fugindo das tropas de Napoleão?
questions.hint: Foi pouco depois da invasão francesa de Portugal, no início do século XIX.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Qual medida de 1808 permitiu que o Brasil comerciasse diretamente com nações amigas de Portugal?
questions.hint: Pense no fim do monopólio comercial português.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Em 1815, o Brasil foi elevado à condição de Reino ___ a Portugal e Algarves. Complete com uma palavra.
questions.hint: A palavra indica que os reinos passaram a ter o mesmo status.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Qual movimento de 1789, em Minas Gerais, foi motivado principalmente pela cobrança de impostos sobre o ouro?
questions.hint: A ameaça da derrama assustava a elite mineira.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Qual movimento ocorrido em Portugal em 1820 exigia a volta do rei para Lisboa?
questions.hint: O nome lembra uma cidade portuguesa.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Em que ano foi proclamada a Independência do Brasil?
questions.hint: Aconteceu um ano depois de D. João VI voltar a Portugal.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: A Constituição de 1824 criou um quarto poder, exclusivo do imperador. Qual?
questions.hint: Esse poder servia, em tese, para 'equilibrar' os outros três.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Como era o voto definido pela Constituição de 1824?
questions.hint: Só votava quem tinha uma renda mínima.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Qual é o nome do período entre a abdicação de D. Pedro I (1831) e a declaração de maioridade de D. Pedro II (1840)?
questions.hint: O país foi governado por regentes.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Qual destas revoltas aconteceu no Período Regencial, no Rio Grande do Sul?
questions.hint: Também é chamada de Guerra dos Farrapos.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Qual revolta regencial ocorreu na província do Grão-Pará e envolveu grande participação popular?
questions.hint: O nome vem das moradias simples dos revoltosos.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: O que foi o Golpe da Maioridade (1840)?
options: A antecipação da maioridade de D. Pedro II para que ele assumisse o trono
A volta de D. Pedro I ao Brasil
questions.answer: A antecipação da maioridade de D. Pedro II para que ele assumisse o trono
questions.hint: O herdeiro tinha apenas 14 anos.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Qual produto se tornou a principal riqueza de exportação do Brasil no Segundo Reinado?
questions.hint: Esse produto se espalhou pelo Vale do Paraíba e depois pelo oeste paulista.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Qual lei de 1850 proibiu o tráfico de africanos escravizados para o Brasil?
questions.hint: Foi aprovada no mesmo ano da Lei de Terras.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Monte uma linha do tempo com quatro acontecimentos estudados (de 1808 a 1850), em ordem, explicando em uma frase por que o primeiro deles ajudou a preparar a Independência.
questions.hint: Comece pela chegada da corte e lembre o que mudou na colônia.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Explique uma semelhança entre as revoltas do Período Regencial e por que elas preocupavam o governo central.
questions.hint: Pense em autonomia das províncias e na unidade do território.

questions.subject: comp
questions.q: Which Python data type stores True or False?
questions.hint: It is named after a 19th-century logician's algebra.

questions.subject: comp
questions.q: In Python, what is the value of 17 // 5?
questions.hint: // is integer (floor) division.

questions.subject: comp
questions.q: In Python, what is the value of 17 % 5?
questions.hint: % gives the remainder.

questions.subject: comp
questions.q: Which loop is most suitable when you know in advance how many times to repeat?
questions.hint: Think about count-controlled iteration.

questions.subject: comp
questions.q: What is the name for a loop that repeats until a condition becomes false, such as WHILE … ENDWHILE?
questions.hint: It is the opposite of count-controlled.

questions.subject: comp
questions.hint: Compare 4 with 5.

questions.subject: comp
questions.q:
What is printed? total = 0
for i in range(1, 4):
    total = total + i
print(total)
questions.hint: range(1, 4) gives 1, 2 and 3.

questions.subject: comp
questions.q: Which component of the CPU carries out arithmetic and logical operations?
questions.hint: Its name includes 'arithmetic'.

questions.subject: comp
questions.q: Which register holds the address of the next instruction to be fetched?
questions.hint: It 'counts' through the program.

questions.subject: comp
questions.q: Name the three stages of the cycle the CPU repeats to run instructions.
questions.hint: The first stage collects an instruction from memory.

questions.subject: comp
questions.q: Which change would usually make a CPU process instructions faster?
questions.hint: Think about cycles per second.

questions.subject: comp
questions.q: Which type of memory is volatile and holds programs currently in use?
questions.hint: Volatile means data is lost when power is off.

questions.subject: comp
questions.q: A program accepts ages 0–120. Which value is boundary test data?
questions.hint: Boundary data sits at the edge of the valid range.

questions.subject: comp
questions.q: Testing a program with the input 'hello' when a number is expected is an example of:
questions.hint: The data is the wrong type.

questions.subject: comp
questions.q: Write pseudocode that asks the user for 5 numbers and outputs their average.
questions.hint: Use a count-controlled loop and a running total.

questions.subject: comp
questions.q: Explain the difference between a syntax error and a logic error, giving an example of each.
questions.hint: One stops the program from running; the other gives the wrong result.

en.topic: Term 1 review: analysis and creative writing

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Which technique is used in 'The wind howled angrily at the door'?
questions.hint: An object is given human feelings.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Which sentence contains a metaphor?
options: The classroom was like a zoo.
questions.hint: A metaphor says something IS something else.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: In an analytical paragraph using PEE/PEEL, what does the 'E' after the point usually stand for?
questions.hint: It is usually a quotation from the text.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: What is the term for a short, one-word or very short sentence used for dramatic effect, such as 'Silence.'?
questions.hint: It is not a full grammatical sentence.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Which word best describes the effect of short sentences in a tense scene?
options: They slow the pace and relax the reader
questions.hint: Think about how quickly you read them.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Which is the best analytical verb to introduce an effect?
questions.hint: Choose the verb that shows interpretation.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: What does 'pathetic fallacy' mean?
options: Using weather or setting to reflect mood
questions.answer: Using weather or setting to reflect mood
questions.hint: Think about storms in dramatic scenes.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: What name is given to a story told from the 'I' perspective?
questions.hint: Count the person: I, you, he/she.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Which opening is most likely to hook the reader in a creative piece?
options: In medias res, starting in the middle of the action
A list of the character's family members
questions.answer: In medias res, starting in the middle of the action
questions.hint: Which one drops you straight into events?

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Which of these is an example of sibilance?
options: The silent sea slipped softly by
questions.answer: The silent sea slipped softly by
questions.hint: Listen for repeated 's' sounds.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: What is a 'cyclical structure' in a narrative?
questions.hint: Think of a circle.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: In a timed exam, what is the best first step for an analysis question?
options: Read the question, underline key words and plan briefly
questions.answer: Read the question, underline key words and plan briefly
questions.hint: A few minutes of planning saves time later.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Which sentence uses a semicolon correctly?
options: The storm passed; the town was silent.
questions.answer: The storm passed; the town was silent.
questions.hint: A semicolon joins two complete, related clauses.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: What word describes the overall feeling or atmosphere of a text (for example, eerie or joyful)?
questions.hint: It is how the text makes the reader feel.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Write a two-sentence opening for a story set in an abandoned railway station, using one sensory detail and one example of personification.
questions.hint: Use sound, smell or touch, and give an object human actions.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Analyse the effect of the phrase 'the city choked on its own smoke'. Write 3–4 sentences, naming the technique.
questions.hint: Think about what 'choked' suggests about the city and the people in it.

en_read.topic: Term 1 review: prose, poetry and non-fiction

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: In Of Mice and Men, where do George and Lennie camp at the start of the novella?
options: By a pool near the Salinas River
questions.answer: By a pool near the Salinas River
questions.hint: The novella begins and ends in the same natural setting.

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: What is George and Lennie's shared dream?
options: To own a small farm of their own
questions.answer: To own a small farm of their own
questions.hint: Lennie keeps asking to hear about it.

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: What job does Lennie dream of having on the farm?
questions.hint: He loves to touch soft things.

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: During which historical period is Of Mice and Men set?
questions.hint: Think about migrant workers in 1930s America.

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: Why is Crooks isolated on the ranch?
questions.hint: Consider attitudes in 1930s America.

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: Which character's old dog is shot by Carlson?
questions.hint: He is the old swamper who lost a hand.

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: What does the shooting of Candy's dog foreshadow?
questions.hint: Who else is seen as a burden in the story?

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: What is the effect of the novella beginning and ending at the same place?
options: It creates a cyclical structure suggesting dreams cannot escape fate
It shows the characters became rich
questions.answer: It creates a cyclical structure suggesting dreams cannot escape fate
questions.hint: Think about whether anything has really changed.

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: What poetic technique is the continuation of a sentence beyond the end of a line, without punctuation?
questions.hint: The sentence runs on to the next line.

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: What is the term for a pause in the middle of a line of poetry, often marked by punctuation?
questions.hint: It can make a line sound broken or hesitant.

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: Many early First World War recruitment poems presented war as:
questions.hint: Think about their purpose: persuading young men to join.

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: Poets writing from the trenches later in the war often aimed to:
options: Show the reality and suffering of war
questions.answer: Show the reality and suffering of war
questions.hint: Consider what soldiers experienced first-hand.

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: An unseen poem says 'the guns' rapid rattle'. Which techniques are used?
questions.hint: Listen to the repeated sound and the word that imitates noise.

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: When approaching an unseen text in an exam, which is the most useful first step?
options: Identify what it is about and the writer's attitude
questions.answer: Identify what it is about and the writer's attitude
questions.hint: Start with the big picture before details.

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: How does the novella Of Mice and Men present loneliness? Refer to one character and use a short quotation or reference. (3–5 sentences)
questions.hint: Consider Crooks, Candy or Curley's wife.

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: Explain how a war poet might use imagery to make the reader feel sympathy for soldiers. Write 3–5 sentences, using an example you invent.
questions.hint: Think about the senses: sight, sound, touch.
